lines.beaver_en: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy nearby?
lines.en: Yes, there is. It's near here.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Which way do I go?
If I go straight, will I reach an intersection?

lines.learner: 왼쪽에 은행이 있어요. 은행 옆에 약국이 있어요.
lines.en: There's a bank on the left. The pharmacy is next to it.
lines.roman: oenjjoge eunhaengi isseoyo. eunhaeng yeope yakgugi isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Next to the bank? Right side or left side?
lines.en: On the bank's right side. It's a big pharmacy.
There's a convenience store across the street.
About five minutes. It's very close.

lines.beaver_en: Is there a bus stop in front of the pharmacy?
lines.en: No, the bus stop is behind the pharmacy.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Is the pharmacy open now?
lines.learner: 네, 밤 열 시까지 해요. 어서 가 보세요.
lines.en: Yes, until 10 p.m. Hurry and go.
lines.roman: ne, bam yeol sikkaji haeyo. eoseo ga boseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you so much. I'll head that way.
